buyer_added_terms.text: 1. Generic OPTION CLAUSE: The Purchaser reserves the right to increase or decrease the quantity to be ordered up to 25 percent of bid quantity at the time of placement of contract. The purchaser also reserves the right to increase the ordered quantity up to 25% of the contracted quantity during the currency of the contract at the contracted rates. The delivery period of quantity shall commence from the last date of original delivery order and in cases where option clause is exercised during the extended delivery period the additional time shall commence from the last date of extended delivery period. The additional delivery time shall be (Increased quantity ÷ Original quantity) × Original delivery period (in days), subject to

minimum of 30 days. If the original delivery period is less than 30 days, the additional time equals the original delivery period. The Purchaser may extend this calculated delivery duration up to the original delivery period while exercising the option clause. Bidders must comply with these terms. 2. Turnover Bidder Turn Over Criteria: The minimum average annual financial turnover of the bidder during the last three years, ending on 31st March of the previous financial year, should be as indicated in the bid document. Documentary evidence in the form of certified Audited Balance Sheets of relevant periods or a certificate from the Chartered Accountant / Cost Accountant indicating the turnover details for the relevant period shall be uploaded with the bid. In case the date of constitution / incorporation of the bidder is less than 3 year old, the average turnover in respect of the completed financial years after the date of constitution shall be taken into account for this criteria. 3. Turnover OEM Turn Over Criteria: The minimum average annual financial turnover of the OEM of the offered product during the last three years, ending on 31st March of the previous financial year, should be as indicated in the bid document. Documentary evidence in the form of certified Audited Balance Sheets of relevant periods or a certificate from the Chartered Accountant / Cost Accountant indicating the turnover details for the relevant period shall be uploaded with the bid. In case the date of constitution / incorporation of the OEM is less than 3 year old, the average turnover in respect of the completed financial years after the date of constitution shall be taken into account for this criteria. In case of bunch bids, the OEM of CATEGORY RELATED TO primary product having highest bid value should meet this criterion. 4. Service & Support Availability of Service Centres: Bidder/OEM must have a Functional Service Centre in the State of each Consignee's Location in case of carry-in warranty. (Not applicable in case of goods having on-site warranty). If service center is not already there at the time of bidding, successful bidder / OEM shall have to establish one within 30 days of award of contract. Payment shall be released only after submission of documentary evidence of having Functional Service Centre. 5. Service & Support Dedicated /toll Free Telephone No. for Service Support : BIDDER/OEM must have Dedicated/toll Free Telephone No. for Service Support. 6. Service & Support Escalation Matrix For Service Support : Bidder/OEM must provide Escalation Matrix of Telephone Numbers for Service Support. 7. Financial Criteria NET WORTH: Net Worth of the OEM should be positive as per the last audited financial statement. 8. Generic Without prejudice to Buyer’s right to price adjustment by way of discount or any other right or remedy available to Buyer, Buyer may terminate the Contract or any part thereof by a written notice to the Seller, if: i) The Seller fails to comply with any material term of the Contract. ii) The Seller informs Buyer of its inability to deliver the Material(s) or any part thereof within the stipulated Delivery Period or such inability otherwise becomes apparent. iii) The Seller fails to deliver the Material(s) or any part thereof within the stipulated Delivery Period and/or to replace/rectify any rejected or defective Material(s) promptly. iv) The Seller becomes bankrupt or goes into liquidation. v) The Seller makes a general assignment for the benefit of creditors. vi) A receiver is appointed for any substantial property owned by the Seller. vii) The Seller has misrepresented to Buyer, acting on which misrepresentation Buyer has placed the Purchase Order on the Seller.

9. Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC Buyer Added text based ATC clauses Buyer-Added Bid-Specific Additional Terms and Conditions (ATC) 1. Financial Documents The bidder shall upload the following documents for the last three completed financial years: - Audited Balance Sheets; - Audited Profit and Loss Accounts; - Income Tax Returns; - GSTR-3B returns, wherever applicable; and - Turnover Certificate issued by a Chartered Accountant with valid UDIN. 2. Notarized Affidavit The bidder shall submit a duly notarized affidavit on applicable non-judicial stamp paper, clearly mentionin g the bid number and confirming: - Acceptance of all bid terms and ATC; - Correctness and authenticity of all uploaded documents; - That the bidder is not bankrupt or insolvent; and - That no liquidation, winding-up, or receivership proceedings are pending against the bidder. 3. Mandatory ISO Certificates The bidder or OEM shall upload valid certificates for the following: - ISO 9001 — Quality Management System; - ISO 45001 — Occupational Health and Safety Management System; - ISO 22975-1:2016 — Solar evacuated tubes; - ISO 9459-1:1993 — Solar water heating system performance; and - ISO 9806:2025 — Solar thermal collector testing. ISO 9001 and ISO 45001 certificates shall be issued by certification bodies accredited by an IAF-member a ccreditation body, cover the relevant activities, and remain valid on the bid submission date. The three sol ar-related certificates shall cover the relevant quoted solar products. 4. ISO Audit Reports The bidder or OEM shall upload the latest applicable surveillance audit report, assessment report, or recert ification audit report supporting the ISO 9001 and ISO 45001 certificates. 5. BIS Licence for Solar Water Heating System The bidder or OEM shall hold and submit a valid BIS licence covering the quoted Solar Water Heating Syste m as per IS 12976:1990. The licence shall clearly indicate the CM/L number, licence holder’s name, manuf acturing location, and scope covering the quoted product. 6. Technical and Performance Requirements

All quoted products shall conform to the technical specifications, dimensions, material requirements, and p erformance parameters prescribed in the bid. 7. Latest Product Test Reports The bidder or OEM shall upload the latest applicable product test reports along with the bid, issued by a Go vernment laboratory or a NABL-accredited laboratory having the relevant tests within its accreditation sco pe. The reports shall establish conformity with the applicable bid specifications and prescribed product sta ndards. Latest applicable test reports shall be submitted separately for each relevant quoted product, clearly ident ifying the product, manufacturer, model/type, applicable standard, test date, and results. 8. Manufacturing Proof or Manufacturer Authorization The bidder shall upload proof of manufacturing the quoted products or relevant authorization issued by the OEM/manufacturer along with the bid. The documents shall clearly cover the quoted products. 9. Product Inspection and Quality Assessment Reports The bidder or OEM shall upload the latest applicable product inspection report, quality assessment report, or factory assessment report for the quoted products, wherever specifically required under the bid. 10. Past Performance and Relevant Item Experience The bidder or OEM shall submit documentary evidence of successfully executing at least one single contra ct for the relevant quoted items, with a contract value of not less than 80% of the estimated bid value. Supporting documents shall include the contract/purchase order and the corresponding satisfactory compl etion or performance certificate issued by the purchaser. 11. Validity and Relevance of Documents All certificates, declarations, affidavits, audited financial documents, BIS licences, authorizations, experienc e documents, EMD documents, test reports, audit reports, and supporting records shall be complete, legibl e, authentic, relevant, and valid at the applicable stage. 12. Consequences of Non-Compliant Documents Submission of false, altered, expired, misleading, unrelated, or unverifiable documents may result in reject ion of the bid and further action under applicable rules. 13. Failure to Submit Mandatory Documents Failure to submit any mandatory document, certificate, BIS licence, audited financial document, test report , or audit report at the stage required under the bid, ATC, corrigendum, or technical specifications may res ult in rejection of the bid or action under the applicable contract terms. 14. Earnest Money Deposit (EMD)

The bidder shall submit EMD of the amount and in the form prescribed in the bid, along with documentary proof. Any claim for exemption shall be supported by the documents required under the applicable bid pro visions. . 10. Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC Buyer uploaded ATC document Click here to view the file.
